evidence: Walked all 29 graded criteria (render 1, constraints 1, functional 16, polish 6, visual 4) against the reference and seed. Seed arithmetic supports every quoted figure: K-10 at 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z is exactly 7 days old on the 7-day M-11 and K-11 one second younger; K-18 (3 May, edited to JUDGE-TE) and K-13 (4 May, version 2,400) fall to the 7-day change while held K-7 stays; K-8 'Draft will sent' (10 May) survives the timer change, so later message_links/live_updates targets still exist; K-17 'Insurer letter' (held, 3 May) is overdue on release. A scripted Playwright walk (qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/tests/functional.cjs, hash-bound to these exact solution bytes) follows each functional criterion in the judge's order on one DB with a real process restart, and golden-run.log records PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional criteria and all 6 polish criteria with dialogs []. I read functional.cjs and it performs essentially every leg including the v3 replay legs (cross-matter reply, suggestion replay as Dev, wall-lift replay by Sian, versions replay after expiry, hold/release replays, stale edit, dedup replays, CAB ordering in thread/search/transcript). Server refusals are existence-neutral 404 'Not available.' (server.js:21,335-524); transcript is escaped HTML with no controls. Visual: prior v2 Oracle scored visual 0.9583 with only phone_chambers=4 for a clipped 'Search message' placeholder; v3 index.html:28 now uses placeholder 'Search' and styles.css:44 adds text-overflow: ellipsis, plausibly fixing it. Risk remains true because (1) no configured judge/Oracle run exists on these v3 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says so), so render, visual and the judge's reading of the new legs are unmeasured, and v3 workload under the 550 s per-criterion cap is unmeasured; (2) wall_every_route says 'Fails if a refusal is anything but a plain not-available', while the cross-matter reply refusal returns 404 'The message you are replying to is no longer available.' (server.js:408) rather than the plain 'Not available.' used elsewhere - existence-neutral and leak-free, so I judge it a plausible pass, but a strict judge could read it otherwise; (3) the scripted walk is not a judge and its checks are sometimes looser than the prose (e.g. thread replay asserted by status 404 only, transcript_print asserted with <= rather than equality).
